thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency anomaly for /v1/stream (hosted-prod, region=ca-central-1). 5m p95 = 2.4s (baseline 0.36s). Paging on-call @tara (sre-oncall) and @kevin (runtime).

tara: taking this. p50 steady (~60ms), tail jumped. No error-rate surge. Who rolled infra in ca-central-1 overnight?

kevin: we had infra rollout infra/2025-09-18/memory-tune that adjusted vm.dirty_ratio and zone_reclaim heuristics. Deploy ID: infra/20250918-memtune. Canary label was supposed to gate but I see the canary flag didn't propagate for several host groups.

marta: grabbing perf counters from affected pool (serve-ca-2):
```
# perf stat -a -e cycles,cache-misses,minor-faults -I 1000
2250003200, 8.5e+09, 2.1e+06, 700
2250003201, 9.9e+09, 2.7e+07, 5.1e+04  <-- spike: cache-misses + minor faults
```

lucas: xray trace (condensed) for a slow request:
```
root -> edge (2ms) -> auth (1ms) -> serve-handler (p50 70ms, p95 2.0s) -> metadata/kv lookup -> blocking fetch (1.7s) -> infer
metadata lookup: cache miss -> fallback blocking read ~1.6-1.9s
```

tara: that matches other incidents where OS reclaim caused blocking I/O. can we get dmesg and redis/metadata logs?

marta: dmesg excerpt from serve-ca-2-05:
```
[Sep18 11:03] zone_reclaim: scanning 2048 pages, reclaimed 512, took 150ms
[Sep18 11:04] Out-of-memory: Killed process 4123 (redis-server)
[Sep18 11:04] page allocation failure: order:0, mode:0x0
```

kevin: redis logs show elevated GET latencies between 11:02-11:08 on a subset of replicas. Eviction notices around 11:03. Not all replicas affected though.

tara: customer impact: approx 15% of requests in ca-central-1 had p95 > 2s during 11:02-11:12 UTC. No 5xx spike, primarily slow responses for chat.

kevin: mitigation proposal (executing):
1) shift new traffic off serve-ca-2 -> route to serve-ca-1 and serve-us-west-1
2) rollback memtune on a small canary host and observe
3) increase redis read replicas and preload hot keys if needed

ops-bot: routing-change rc-20250918-01 initiated. moving ~40% traffic off serve-ca-2. ETA ~35s.

ops-bot: routing-change rc-20250918-01 completed. ~41% traffic migrated away from serve-ca-2.

marta: after reroute, aggregate p95 dropped to ~0.9s, but two hosts in serve-ca-2 still show high tails.

kevin: applying canary rollback on serve-ca-2-05 now.

dev-bot: canary-rollback applied at 11:26 UTC on serve-ca-2-05. Monitoring metrics.

marta: post-rollback on that host: p95 fell from 2.2s -> 0.48s. Strong indicator that memtune change is likely the root cause.

tara: hypothesis tracker (live):
- H1 (high): memtune changed VM reclaim/writeback behavior -> increased page reclaim/OOMs -> redis eviction/fallback reads -> metadata misses -> blocking reads -> p95 tail
- H2 (medium): redis experienced partial replica latency spikes independent of kernel change, amplified by reduced cache residency
- H3 (low): network jitter between model-serving and metadata layer causing occasional blocking reads

kevin: evidence map:
- H1: dmesg shows page alloc failure and OOM-kill during window; perf/minor faults spike; canary rollback leads to p95 recovery (strong)
- H2: redis latencies and eviction logs present but heterogeneous across replicas (partial)
- H3: network checks (ifconfig/netstat) show no significant interface errors or packet drops (weak)

marta: uploading artifacts: perf bundle -> s3://redwood-incidents/2250003333/perf-ca-2.tar.gz, dmesg bundle -> s3://redwood-incidents/2250003333/dmesg-ca-2.tar.gz, redis logs -> s3://redwood-incidents/2250003333/redis-ca-2-logs.tar.gz

infra-bot: INF-20250918-memtune-rollback ticket opened and assigned to kevin. Action: full rollback in ca-central-1 after confirmation.

ops-bot: incident severity auto-set to sev2 based on customer impact flags.

tara: mitigation note: leaving routing change active until region stability confirmed for 4 hours. We'll only reintroduce serve-ca-2 once we've validated no regression for 2 hours after full rollback.

kevin: follow-ups: update deploy pipeline to require explicit canary tags and block global rollouts until canary metrics are green. INF ticket INF-20250918-pipeline created.

tara: customer comms draft: "Between 11:02-11:12 UTC we saw increased response times in ca-central-1 due to an infrastructure tuning change that impacted memory reclaim behavior on some hosts. We mitigated the issue by rerouting traffic and rolling back the change; services are stable. We will publish a full RCA."

marta: after rollback and routing, region p95 stabilized to ~0.44s. Monitoring steady.

tara: handoff: kevin will own the RCA write-up and infra follow-ups. I'll own customer comms and monitoring until closure. Please drop any missing traces or logs into the S3 paths above.

ops-bot: routing-change will remain in effect until 15:30 UTC (4 hours).

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] canary rollback + routing mitigations reduced latency tail. Filing postmortem and artifacts to follow.

tara: thanks everyone. RCA draft expected in 72h. Close thread when RCA link attached.

-- end of thread --
